label: D2 after choosing a2 and landing rare in S1, mostly after an unrewarded trial or early in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO). 98% of the activation mass is on steps where the input shows a2 was chosen and S1 was reached, i.e. the rare transition a2->S1. On the other rare transition (a1->S2) it almost never fires, and on common transitions it is nearly silent. The bare predicate (D2 & a2 & S1) has dev recall 0.92 and mass recall 0.98, but precision is only 0.52: about half of a2->S1 rare events do not activate it. Activation is more likely and stronger when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 80% of the mass, and nearly all of the top quartile) and earlier in the episode (the firing rate drops steadily from trial 0 to trial 99). Adding (prev_reward==0 | ep_trial<40) raises dev F1 to 0.75 (P 0.73, R 0.77, mass 0.92). The rate is also higher when the next choice will be a switch, but that was not used. The predicate uses only observed variables: action and state are visible at D2.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues.
